1113.title: Drops
1113.lore: According to myth , Drops were created from Odin's Saliva just like Poring. In fact both Poring and Drops are created together. Drops is a bubble-like or blob like monster. Drops are also known for their resemblance to orange gelatin. The general shape of a Drops is similar to that of a water droplet but frozen in jelly form. Drops move by bouncing up and down and can attack by propelling themselves at other monsters (or, more commonly, at players). It has adapted well in hot climate .…

1116.lore:
A weird robotic egg looking thing that waddles when it walks. No one knows where these things come from.
It can be seen in numbers in Payon Cave. No knows how it got there in the first place.
Eggyra have a pair of red eyes. Its shell is thick and firm as much as the one of Peco Peco but hollow on the inside.
The Shell is seperated to two section , the top part which consist of a pair of two red eyes and the bottom part which consist of a pair of its leg.…

1117.title: Evil Druid
1117.lore:
A flamboyant Evil Druid commonly seen in the Glast Heim Chruch Yard and some of Glast Heim area as well. It is always using a floating spellbook that crackles with energy to cause misery to adventurers.
Once , he was a prominent high priest , but a curse turned him into one of the undead. As he used to be a high priest he is a pretty strong monster.
History
In truth Evil Druid was the chosen priest that used to work closely with the King of Glast Heim which is now the Dark Lord.…

1121.lore:
Giearth is dwarflike creatures who live underground , looking for ores.They wears a miner clothing and equipped with a goggle helmet. They prefer to live underground . They gathers ores and processes them. Who knows what he plan to do with it. It rarely initiate attacks unless somebody tries to steal his possession or to attack first.
Nobody knows where they actually come from , they seems to just pop up out of no where.…

1130.title: Jakk
1130.lore:
Jakk is a strange-looking monster with a pumpkin head and wearing a tuxedo. Nobody knows where it came from, however according to the monster scholars it might be a familiar of a demon from the demon realm.
It likes to chase girls who are good-looking, mistaking them for their "one true love".
Oda: The name Jakk comes from "Jack O' Lantern", the common name for the carved pumpkins that decorate homes around halloween.…

1138.lore: A spirit of the unborn chick after the Peco Peco egg was broken. It takes a pan to attack. It has a dream of becoming a chick, but if you want to talk about the chicken-or-egg question with it, you will definitely be attacked!

1147.title: Maya
1147.lore: Maya is the Queen of the Monster Ant that dwells in the AntHell Colony. She is the reproducing female ant in an ant colony, generally she will be the mother of all the other ants. Although her appearance resemble nothing of a normal ant , she is still considered as one. Her origin is not related to any normal ants nor any of her subordinates and childrens. She is a unique ant and considered to be special in alot of ways. Some even suggest that she is the origin of all Ants in the world.…

1150.title: Moonlight Flower
1150.lore:
Moonlight flower is a half demon half mortal or better known with the nick name Demon Cat due to her appearance. Although in reality she has no relation to cat what so ever. Her looks are actually inherited from a demon fox.
She has the appearance of a little girl with a hand/paw and legs of a fox. She also have a long fluffy tail. Moonlight also have that iconic fox bonnet that she always wear on her head. She also have a large bell that she always carry around.…

1267.title: Carat
1267.lore:
Carat is a Jester that lurks in the Glast Heim Castle. It can be seen around the corridors and in some room trying to entertain anyone that he can find. Although none of the undead really get his joke.
Carat always sit on its big ball , and moves around by bouncing it here and there.
Carat is a coward. It is easily scared and might attack anyone when its scared.…

Alice is a maid typed robot that has been taking charge of miscellaneous trifles in castles or mansion. Cleaning is her priority of daily life, however she shows no mercy to intruders and attacks them driving a steel broom.

1312.lore:
Turtle General is the known leader of all the turtles that reside in Turtle Island. Turtle General is listed as MVP.
Despite his age . and the stereotype of turtle being slow , Turtle General is actually fast and agile. He has mastered the art of twin blades and very good at close combat.

1317.lore:

Fur Seal is a fin-footed marine mammals which are semiaquatic . It has sleek-body and barrel-shaped. Their bodies are well adapted to the aquatic habitat where they spend most of their lives. Due to the excessive hunting for their precious hide , Fur Seal are now threatened with extinction. Fur Seal can only be found at Cocomo beach , Comodo.
Fur Seal is always mistaken for a Sea Otter. This is because Fur Seal has habbit of disguising itself to be a Sea Otter.…

1365.lore:
Apocalypse is the name of an android that used to guard Jusperos long ago.
Information
It was created by an ancient civilization of Jusperos before the whole the whole city collapse to the ground.
Like most android and robot , Apocalypse too had survived the crash. They were built to withstand any kind of damage. It was also built to last for a long time. Unfortunatly none of citizen of Jusperos survived , all perish during the crash.…

1368.title: Geographer
1368.lore: Geographer, a monster looks like a flower blooming from the ground. Strangely, it can extend its body a long distance. Even if you're far away from it, it can still pose a threat. The name of this monster originated from a story about a poor geographer who, unfortunately, was eaten by this monster while he was immersed in his studies.

1370.lore: Succubus is a demon from Geffenia bearing an uncanny resemblance to a human woman, save for a pair of red wings and horns extending forward. 1371.title: False Angel
1371.lore:
There exists a fallen angel named 'False Angel.' It feigns innocence, pretending to bless adventurers and then stabbing them in the back without any warning.
Don't be fooled by its appearance, or you'll find yourself in trouble.
False Angel used to be a cupid angel long ago. It was supposed to bring love to the human on Midgard , but a demon appears and corrupted the poor angel. It whispers evil deeds to the angels ears.…

'Goat' is a monster that was an antelope living in the high mountains that was somehow turned into a monster. Regardless of how it looks like it was actually a real antelope.…
